manifest.design: 9 new boards, 3 per size. 90 trajectories; stop on first local violation or oracle-unextendable prefix. Every attempt starts empty; repeated attempts get identical prompts at identical states. No correction, feedback, backtracking, sampling, or global candidate filtering. Raw menus include all cells in selected region; local menus remove immediate rule violations only. Separate exact-byte probes and question-batch controls.
